mobile-sidebar-hidden.png: Mobile viewport (390px) with the sidebar closed: the collapsed icon rail is gone and the conversation keeps the full width. The header carries the panel-left toggle.
mobile-sidebar-drawer.png: Tapping the header toggle opens the sidebar as a 300px drawer over the still-full-width conversation, with a tap-anywhere scrim.
mobile-panel-toggle.png: On a global panel (Plugins) there is no header slot to inject into, so the toggle falls back to a fixed control in the shell overlay layer.
desktop-unchanged.png: At 1280px nothing changes: the 280px sidebar is intact and neither control is rendered.
